title: Ceres Intro

nodes.speaker: Ceres Coilson
nodes.text: I might be wasting my time because, well, the floor around here is filthy, but... have you seen a FLAVR unit?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I might be wasting my time because, well, the floor around here is filthy, but... have you seen a FLAVR unit?

nodes.speaker: Ceres Coilson
nodes.text: Oh this really must be an educationally deprived area. I'm looking for a Floor Level Autonomous Vacuum Robot... a cleaning droid... a suction bot! Have you seen one here?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Oh this really must be an educationally deprived area. I'm looking for a Floor Level Autonomous Vacuum Robot... a cleaning droid... a suction bot! Have you seen one here?

nodes.speaker: Ceres Coilson
nodes.text: Not that it’s any of your business, but ...

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Not that it’s any of your business, but ...

nodes.speaker: Ceres Coilson
nodes.text: Look, I need help.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Look, I need help.

nodes.speaker: Ceres Coilson
nodes.text: I had my husband loaded up on a small chip before he died, and now it has... escaped.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I had my husband loaded up on a small chip before he died, and now it has... escaped.

nodes.speaker: Ceres Coilson
nodes.text: I’m currently locked out of my Hetherington's Country Club account. Now I’d very much appreciate it if you could go and check if my husband is inside a vacuum cleaner.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I’m currently locked out of my Hetherington's Country Club account. Now I’d very much appreciate it if you could go and check if my husband is inside a vacuum cleaner.

nodes.speaker: Ceres Coilson
nodes.text: Look, Gan and I need to remain in contact, he was always in charge of our passwords.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Look, Gan and I need to remain in contact, he was always in charge of our passwords.

nodes.speaker: Ceres Coilson
nodes.text: Yes.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Yes.

nodes.speaker: Ceres Coilson
nodes.text: Yes, a Persona Construct… surely you know what I'm talking about… It’s a process by which a sentient AI program, based on a person’s living persona is constructed so they can be communicated with after death.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Yes, a Persona Construct… surely you know what I'm talking about… It’s a process by which a sentient AI program, based on a person’s living persona is constructed so they can be communicated with after death.

nodes.speaker: Ceres Coilson
nodes.text: No, it is not romantic. There were many practical reasons why Gan and I should remain in contact. He was always in charge of our passwords.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: No, it is not romantic. There were many practical reasons why Gan and I should remain in contact. He was always in charge of our passwords.

nodes.speaker: Ceres Coilson
nodes.text: I have reason to believe my late husband’s Persona Construct accidentally found itself stuck inside a FLAVR, and I’d very much like to get it back.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I have reason to believe my late husband’s Persona Construct accidentally found itself stuck inside a FLAVR, and I’d very much like to get it back.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: ...A what?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: ...A what?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Yes, I have seen a vacuum cleaner nearby. Why?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Yes, I have seen a vacuum cleaner nearby. Why?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Yes, I have seen a vacuum cleaner nearby. Why?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Yes, I have seen a vacuum cleaner nearby. Why?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: None of your business lady.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: None of your business lady.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Persona Construct?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Persona Construct?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: How romantic.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: How romantic.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: 'It'? Do you mean 'he'?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: 'It'? Do you mean 'he'?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I still don't see why I should help you.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I still don't see why I should help you.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: I still don't see why I should help you.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: I still don't see why I should help you.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: If I check, will you leave?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: If I check, will you leave?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: If I check, will you leave?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: If I check, will you leave?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I promised not to tell you. Why do you ask?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I promised not to tell you. Why do you ask?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: I promised not to tell you. Why do you ask?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: I promised not to tell you. Why do you ask?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Well, I keep my promises. You're on your own.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Well, I keep my promises. You're on your own.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Well, I keep my promises. You're on your own.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Well, I keep my promises. You're on your own.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: And?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: And?
